time: Gates open noon Friday, music from 4 pm
address: Bosbury Lane, Hartwell Cross, near Ledbury HR8 2LW
entry: Weekend £95 with camping, Saturday or Sunday £45, under-12s free with an adult

items.title: Gates and campsite open
items.place: Box office, top of the car park
items.note: Swap your ticket for a wristband here. Pitch anywhere in the Long Meadow; the Quiet Field is for families.

items.title: The Calloway Stringband
items.note: Friday headliners. Two hours, with an interval for the bar.

items.title: Songs round the fire
items.note: Bring an instrument or a voice. The fire is out at one.

items.title: Dandelion Clock
items.note: Songs for small people and their grown-ups.

items.title: Lantern making
items.note: Willow, tissue and a tea light. Free; ages five and up.

items.title: Lantern parade
items.place: From the orchard to the Meadow stage
items.note: Follow the drums. Lanterns from the craft tent, or bring your own.

items.title: DJ Sorrel
items.note: Until 1 am. The Quiet Field stays quiet from midnight.

items.title: The Hartwell Ceilidh Band
items.note: Every dance is called. Nobody needs to know the steps.

items.title: Odette Marsh
items.note: The last set of the weekend.

items.title: Last orders
items.note: The campsite stays open until 10 am on Monday.

people.name: Juniper Vale
people.note: Five-piece folk-rock from Bristol, with the whole of their second album.

people.name: The Calloway Stringband
people.note: Fiddle, banjo and three-part harmony from Shetland.

people.name: Odette Marsh
people.note: Songs from the Fens, with a string trio.
